description.p: Ruqa is a free, open-source app for sending files straight between devices. Two phones in the same room find each other over the local network and transfer without a router, without mobile data and without any server in between. When the devices are apart, the transfer goes peer-to-peer over the internet — end-to-end encrypted, with no size limit and no upload step.
Why use cloud storage — or wait for signal at all — when the file can go straight to the recipient?

ul.li: Works with no internet — two devices on the same Wi-Fi transfer directly
No accounts — no signup, no login, no email address required
No servers — files transfer directly device-to-device
End-to-end encrypted — only your devices can read your files
No file size limit — send a 100 MB photo or 500 GB video archive
